project.name: OpenXR Operator
project.summary: Build XR experiences by describing them. A local AI agent watches a running Godot app, proposes changes in plain language, and only acts after a human approves each one. No coding required to use it, no hosted service required to run it.

nodes.label: Demo Godot app
nodes.summary: The little test app the agent watches and changes: a status label and XR controllers.

nodes.label: Godot addon
nodes.summary: Lives inside the running app and answers the agent over an authenticated local channel: scene tree, captures, property changes, controller input.

nodes.label: Python agent
nodes.summary: The local brain: observes the app, asks the model for the next action, and executes only approved changes.

nodes.label: Engine channel
nodes.summary: Talks to the addon over a token-first, loopback-only WebSocket, and verifies every captured frame before trusting it.

nodes.label: Flow runner
nodes.summary: Runs repeatable, model-free test flows and writes a full evidence bundle with JUnit output.

nodes.label: Model backends
nodes.summary: Picks and calls AI backends — local Ollama by default, hosted only if a human opts in — with hard blocks on excluded vendors and no automatic fallback.

nodes.label: Action loop and approvals
nodes.summary: The safety core: model output is validated, contained, summarized in plain language for approval, then executed and hash-chained into the audit log.

nodes.label: Browser control panel
nodes.summary: The part a non-developer actually uses: a task box and plain-language Approve/Reject cards, token-gated on loopback only.

nodes.label: Test suite
nodes.summary: 130 executed tests proving the gates: rejected actions never reach the engine, tampering is detected, pins fail closed.

nodes.label: Saved test flows
nodes.summary: YAML flows saved from sessions — the power-user and regression layer, never hand-written by end users.

nodes.label: CI and security gates
nodes.summary: Vendor scan, licence and bind gates, digest-pinned actions, secrets scanning and SBOM generation, all blocking.

nodes.label: Kit and decisions
nodes.summary: The build kit, frozen contracts, and the decision register that explains why the system looks the way it does.

nodes.label: OpenXR API layer (v2)
nodes.summary: Optional explicit, environment-scoped layer for capturing the true composited headset frame. Deferred in v1 (D-04).

nodes.label: Local model server
nodes.summary: Ollama on loopback: the default, offline, digest-pinned vision model (qwen2.5vl:7b). Project data never leaves the machine.

edges.label: ws://127.0.0.1:9099
edges.description: Token-first authenticated WebSocket: the only channel between the agent and the engine.

edges.label: observes and mutates
edges.description: The addon reads the scene tree, captures frames, sets properties and injects controller input in the running demo app.

edges.label: /api/chat (local inference)
edges.description: One schema-constrained action per step, digest-pinned model, no automatic fallback to any other provider.
